_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for supported languages, read by the app (src/config/languages.ts) and by every build script (scripts/lib/locale-fallback.mjs). The rules that turn it into fallback chains live in src/config/language-rules.mts. The kit ships de and en, each with its Easy-Language variant.
_defaultLanguage: Site default: where a visitor with no URL prefix, no stored choice and no matching browser language lands. Drives the bare-URL redirect in src/index.html, hreflang x-default, the sitemap x-default and the language signal before detection.
_keySourceLanguage: Canonical key source for the UI strings (src/assets/i18n/modules/<lang>/). Every locale must carry its keys (check-i18n-keys.mjs), and it is the last resort when a UI key is missing at runtime.
_contentReferenceLanguage: Reference tree for CONTENT (glossary, timeline, sources, ...): the most complete one, and the last resort of the content-bundle fallback chain (scripts/build-unified-content.ts, check-content-coverage.mjs).
